default-preset.tooltip: Use as the reference for the blue dot and as the last entry in the preset menu. Selecting a default does not load a preset.

reference-note.description: When a default preset is selected, a blue dot indicates that the current overall settings differ from the default preset. This setting does not load anything at startup.

menu-title-controls.description: Launch Easy Effects from the menu

ee-autostart.tooltip: Start EasyEffects as a background service at login. If its settings window is already open, reopen it to see external autostart changes.

ee-autostart-note.description: Recommended: enable this so the service is ready in the background when you log in.

ee-shutdown-on-window-close.tooltip: Quit EasyEffects when its window closes. This setting is synchronized in both directions with the EasyEffects settings window.

ee-shutdown-on-window-close-note.description: Recommended: disable this so the service keeps running when the window is closed.
